scopeNote: Zero model and native turns. No fee/recipe research, no new Driver, no second database/ledger, no probe-only recover authority. Two historical reports left untouched. Shared probe output written to /tmp.

B2.label: validate the payload that will actually be sent; full Windows redaction
B2.rootCause: all four shared one cause: validating the caller object instead of the payload, while cloning is exactly what destroys the evidence
B2.twoPass: a hazard scan runs on the caller object (symbol keys on objects AND arrays, accessors refused because a getter's value is not stable), then the value is cloned and the CLONE is validated as JSON
B2.nonPlainRefused: Map/Set/Date/class instances are refused: a Map of required context would serialise to {} and arrive empty
B2.windowsRedaction: separator-aware alternatives now consume the whole drive path, the UNC form and the POSIX form, so no account or trailing component survives

B1.label: recovery against an independent surviving Runner
proven: the Runner is its own long-lived process; the coordinator dies by SIGKILL while Runner pid stays alive
recovery is a fresh coordinator that reaches the SAME living Runner pid, with recovered exit code asserted 0
receiver counters come from inside the Runner and show one begin receipt with no duplicated stop
post-recovery delivery records once into the still-open writer
an epoch-1 cancel is refused before it reaches the writer, whose cancel counter stays unchanged
open: the stop-ACK unknown window: the cancel returned without error and exited 0, yet the receiver served 0 cancels, so the window is NOT covered. Cause undetermined between harness and product; recorded as a FAIL rather than claimed
2/4-slot queues, output caps, backpressure and FD/child/queue return-to-baseline are not covered

limitations: the writer is a fixture process; no installed vendor agent was executed
answer/stop/steer against a real vendor turn and unknown-send reconciliation remain NOT_TESTED
the stop-ACK window is open: the cancel never reached the receiver and the cause was not isolated
2/4-slot, output caps, backpressure and resource-return matrices are not covered
